resources.string: Lets the Letta environment agent operate this phone: read screen content, tap, swipe, and type on your behalf. Only you grant it, and you can revoke it any time in Settings > Accessibility.

WHAT THIS DOES
The agent gains the ability to use your phone like a person does: see what is on screen, tap buttons, swipe, and type text. It could, for example, read a QR code from an app, reply in a messaging app, or change a setting for you.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
It cannot install apps, delete anything, or act while you have not asked. Nothing leaves your phone — screen content is processed locally.

YOUR CONTROL
You grant it with one toggle. You can revoke it at any time (Settings > Accessibility). A persistent notification shows when the agent is using it.

To finish: Settings > Accessibility > Installed apps > Letta Environment Agent > On > Allow.
